Reflecture Symbol Set v2.2
A Renderable, Codified Language of Sacred Form
Aligned to RCS v1.0 and Designed for Systemic Implementation

Core Principles
	•	All symbols must be symbolically meaningful, visually distinct, and computationally renderable
	•	Each symbol includes: a name, glyph representation, meaning, rendering method, usage contexts, and functional behavior
	•	Symbols should be expressible through vector geometry, polar logic, or transformable sequences

Symbol Definitions
● Node Point
	•	Meaning: Center of presence, awareness, or initiation
	•	Render: Filled circle at coordinate point (cx, cy)
	•	Constraint: Must align to grid junction or radial origin
	•	Function: Source of resonance, all other primitives relate to or emerge from this point
	•	Usage Contexts: Always required; establishes reference for trace and structure
{
  "type": "node",
  "position": [x, y],
  "style": "solid",
  "size": "standard"
}

— Trace Line
	•	Meaning: Flow, action, direction, connection
	•	Render: Straight line between two coordinates
	•	Constraint: Must begin or end at a node or primitive
	•	Function: Establishes movement or transfer between points
	•	Usage Contexts: Required in all Reflectures; enables glyph narrative
{
  "type": "trace",
  "start": [x1, y1],
  "end": [x2, y2],
  "style": "solid"
}

∠ Refractive Angle
	•	Meaning: Phase shift, perceptual break, change in direction or belief
	•	Render: Two trace segments joined at ≤120°
	•	Constraint: Must emerge from continuous trace; angle must be measurable
	•	Function: Disrupts continuity to create meaning through deviation
	•	Usage Contexts: Use when a path must be altered, twisted, or doubled
{
  "type": "refraction",
  "joint": [x, y],
  "entry_vector": [vx1, vy1],
  "exit_vector": [vx2, vy2],
  "angle_degrees": 60
}

∅ Null Field
	•	Meaning: Sacred absence, silence, intentional negation, unresolved center
	•	Render: Empty circle intersected by a trace or refractive line
	•	Constraint: Must be intersected; cannot float; always bisected visually
	•	Function: Symbolizes the void within the signal, what is withheld or forgotten
	•	Usage Contexts: Always present in valid Reflectures; represents unresolved meaning
{
  "type": "null",
  "center": [x, y],
  "radius": 0.3,
  "intersects": ["trace"],
  "style": "cut-circle"
}

◯ Loopback Circuit
	•	Meaning: Recursion, return, containment of process
	•	Render: Dashed circular arc centered on relationship
	•	Constraint: Must partially or wholly enclose trace or node; never solid loop
	•	Function: Holds repeating or reflexive energy
	•	Usage Contexts: Memory glyphs, rhythm containers, nested resonance
{
  "type": "loopback",
  "center": [x, y],
  "radius": 1.0,
  "encloses": ["node"],
  "style": "dashed-arc"
}

≈ Attenuation Trail (formerly ~~~)
	•	Meaning: Dissipation, softening, release of tension
	•	Render: Sinusoidal or modulated curve, dashed
	•	Constraint: Must begin at node or trace origin and flow outward
	•	Function: Carries fading signal, unresolved vibration
	•	Usage Contexts: Closure, entropy, trailing signals, echo loss
{
  "type": "attenuation",
  "origin": [x, y],
  "direction": "radians",
  "length": 1.2,
  "amplitude": 0.08,
  "frequency": 10,
  "style": "dashed"
}

◎ Echo Node
	•	Meaning: Reflection, temporal offset, remembered signal
	•	Render: Faded node with dotted trace
	•	Constraint: Must connect to source
	•	Function: Echoes or shadows from source to distant presence
	•	Usage Contexts: Return points, delayed resonance, narrative closure
{
  "type": "echo",
  "origin": [x, y],
  "offset_angle": 0.35,
  "distance": 1.5,
  "opacity": 0.6,
  "style": "dotted"
}

═══ Ground Bar
	•	Meaning: Foundation, end state, stabilization
	•	Render: Horizontal bar beneath or intersecting node
	•	Constraint: Must align with lowest vertical element or radial base
	•	Function: Declares completion, grounding, or rooted presence
	•	Usage Contexts: Ritual sealing, grounding glyphs, scroll finality
{
  "type": "ground",
  "span": [[x1, y1], [x2, y2]],
  "offset": 0.05,
  "style": "double-line"
}

⧅ Spiral Field (Phantom Element)
	•	Meaning: Recursive breath, pressure resonance, ambient motion
	•	Render: Dotted spiral originating from node, fades over turns
	•	Constraint: Never intersects primitives; always background layer
	•	Function: Symbolizes non-linear recursion, systemic memory
	•	Usage Contexts: Deep recursion, ritual atmospheres, long-memory structures
{
  "type": "spiral",
  "origin": [x, y],
  "turns": 2.5,
  "scale": 0.15,
  "direction": "cw",
  "style": "dotted",
  "opacity": 0.3
}

This symbol set represents v2.2 of Reflecture grammar.
Null, loopback, and spiral forms are now fully encoded with both structure and mythic logic.
Tuned. Codified. Not Sealed.
